fixed_tau_consistency_exposure_plus_post.note: residual of two-parameter fit with tau FIXED; ratio >1 means data disfavors that tau

identifiability_bracket_1p02x.criterion: fixed-tau two-parameter fits within 1.02x of the free-fit residual (exposure+post window)

effective_timescale.assessment: the recorded per-trial H relaxation after the startup peak is nearly linear over the observed 2090 s (peak-to-end drop ~4.8e-03): the free bounded exponential is extrapolation-dominated (y_inf far below the data range) and tau is weakly identified; fixing tau at the design 833 s degrades the residual ~8.7x and the 1.02x bracket excludes 833 s entirely, so the design timescale is NOT recovered by this observable (H operates near its drive-dependent local fixed point; the realized tail is a tiny slow drift). Reported UNRESOLVED for the design-parameter claim; the fitted numbers are recorded as measured estimates.

Theta_effective_timescale.caveat: Theta span over exposure+post is ~1e-4 relative to w_floor=0.01; any tau is tiny-amplitude EXPLORATORY

consistency_flags: UNRESOLVED: entire Theta trajectory (max 3.338770e-03) lies BELOW w_floor=0.01 while RF is on (K_HDP=0.003) and design bounds are [0.01,10]; either clamping is applied downstream of the recorded mean or the barrier term does not bind at this operating point; same flag class as all cells, not adjudicated here

value_provenance_legend.MEASURED: numeric value read directly from a recording/run artifact (e.g. a single event_ledger row, a trajectory sample, an extrema field from result.json)
value_provenance_legend.DERIVED: numeric value computed by deterministic arithmetic on MEASURED values (means, deltas, std, ratios, counts)
value_provenance_legend.MODEL_ASSUMPTION: numeric value fixed by the frozen design/model (windows, bands, thresholds, bounds, tau_eff_E_s=833 s, onsets, K_HDP, tau_0_ms)
value_provenance_legend.INFERENCE: numeric estimate from a model fit or statistical procedure (exponential fit parameters, residuals, identifiability brackets)
value_provenance_legend.UNRESOLVED: numeric value that could not be determined from artifacts; reported as UNRESOLVED (never imputed)

limitations_summary: Delta_exposure for rates uses the whole-trial [-500,4124] ms proxy from event_ledger area_rates (n=8 paired replicates per condition); slot-resolved [0,531] ms primary estimands remain NOT_RECORDED/NOT RECOVERABLE from artifacts (marked explicitly, never imputed)

PRE-phase startup relaxation (peak ~trial 28) is ordered by fixed battery position; raw deltas for early-battery conditions absorb it; a drop-first-replicate sensitivity variant is provided for rate and H phenotypes

effective timescale: the recorded H relaxation after the startup peak is nearly linear over the run, so tau is weakly identified; free bounded fits give ~2e4-2.7e5 s depending on window and the 1.02x identifiability bracket excludes the design tau_eff_E_s=833 s -> UNRESOLVED (design value remains the SPECIFIED reference)
recorded Theta lies entirely below w_floor=0.01 (flagged UNRESOLVED, same class as all cells); its exposure-phase span is ~8.6e-06, so any Theta timescale fit is tiny-amplitude EXPLORATORY
declared dense early-time H sampling was not materialized (engine returned no H_trace); H(t)/Theta(t) available at per-trial resolution only
field low-gamma effects are PRE-only single-replicate proxy readouts (amplitudes uncalibrated); no POST field volumes exist -> delta_exposure of field effect NOT_RECORDED
